name: Friend to Pet
source:
You and your friends randomly found a tarot reader in the wild, so you decided to get a couple of readings. Just as you were about to leave after the session ended, she regrettably informed you of having to pay for it! However, you all thought it was a free service and unfortunately didn't have enough money in your pockets, so as payment she cursed your friend and turned them into a pet instead.

Will you be able to free your poor friend from this curse and turn them back to human? Or will they forever stay as a pet? Their future is in your hands...

[From [url=https://cillypod.itch.io/friend-to-pet]itch.io[/url]]
